name: Transliterate Twig
description: Creates a twig filter for transliterating strings (without PECL)
project_description:
The module adds a Twig filter for transliterating strings without PECL. It registers a single Twig filter named 'tl' that converts accented and non-ASCII characters to their closest ASCII equivalents by delegating to Drupal core's own \Drupal\Component\Transliteration\PhpTransliteration service. It implements the same functionality as the Transliterate Twig Filter module (https://www.drupal.org/project/transliterate), but using only Drupal functions, so no PECL/intl extension is required.

Example:

 {{ 'résidence' | tl }} => residence
